instruction: Change the font size of titles in slides 1, 2, and 3 to 60 pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing title font size in slides 1, 2, and 3 to 60 pt. Evaluator extracts title font size from these slides and verifies it matches 60pt (±2pt tolerance).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 = All 3 titles are 60pt, 0.67 = 2 titles are 60pt, 0.33 = 1 title is 60pt, 0.0 = No titles are 60pt
metadata.verification: Verified by analyzing actual PowerPoint file structure: file contains 6 slides with titles in Gloria Hallelujah and Poppins fonts. Target slides identified based on slide indices.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Title detection logic is unreliable - getter identifies titles by finding the shape with the largest font size, which may not be the actual title
Before task completion, if title font size is smaller than body text, the getter will not find the correct title shape
After task completion, the heuristic might accidentally select body text that happens to have 60pt font size instead of the actual title
The getter should use PowerPoint's placeholder type (shape.placeholder_format.type) or check for title placeholder specifically, not rely on font size heuristic
Edge case: Getter only checks first run of first paragraph - if title has mixed formatting across runs, only first run is verified
Postconfig correctly saves file before verification (positive aspect)
Metric comparison logic is correct with appropriate tolerance (positive aspect)
All 3 target slides are checked with proper partial credit scoring (positive aspect)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace font-size-based title detection with proper placeholder type checking: use shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type to identify title placeholders
Alternative: Check if shape has placeholder_format and type equals PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE or CENTRAL_TITLE
Alternative: Use shape names or positions - titles are typically the first text shape or have specific naming patterns
Add validation to ensure the detected shape is actually a title before extracting properties
Consider checking all runs in the title paragraph to ensure consistent font size across the entire title text
